issues.explanation: Comparing enum-typed $membership->role to UserRole::X->value strings always fails so manageSettings/assignRole always deny and owner-membership delete guard never triggers.
submit() is declared void but returns a redirect, which is a PHP TypeError, and it never retries on slug unique-violation as the task requires.
Entity uses #[SoftDeletes] attribute without the SoftDeletes trait so soft deletes are not enabled contrary to the contract.
CurrentEntity only aborts when route entity id differs from session id and never checks membership of the session entity or requested entity.
Navbar link to entity.switcher conditioned on membership count was not added and switcher route wrongly adds current_entity middleware causing a redirect loop.
uniqueSlug only loops on exists() with no try/catch retry around the insert transaction for concurrent slug collisions.
EntityFactory slugs with Str::slug($name) without uniqueness and owner_seq generated column is not marked stored as required.
Domain write creates Entity/Membership directly in Livewire instead of one app/Actions class and routes check membership manually instead of using policies/gates.
Livewire validates via $this->validate(['name'=>...]) with WithValidation trait instead of #[Validate] plus $this->validate() and no $this->authorize call exists.
docs/database-schema.md 162-line model was replaced with 3 lines and both lang/ui.php files deleted all existing login/verify keys.
Route middleware alias is registered via new app/Http/Kernel.php $routeMiddleware which is not loaded on current Laravel bootstrap.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship in the diff, including required unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Tenant dispatch count/set-session logic is duplicated in CurrentEntity middleware and the /home route closure with extra Kernel file.
Switcher buttons add inline style attributes and void-return redirect makes control flow unclear versus sibling style.
Lang deletions and full schema-doc deletion remove unrelated existing content beyond what the task asked to add/update.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:12 uses WithValidation + validate([...]) not #[Validate]; routes/web.php:991 manual membershipFor check not policy; no app/Actions/*; docs/database-schema.md replaced, lang files deleted

readability.evidence: Clear names and small methods (uniqueSlug, membershipFor, owner/admin/employee scopes) but app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:19 return redirect in void and resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php inline styles hurt clarity

requirements.evidence: app/Policies/* enum-vs-string always false; app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php no insert retry + void return; app/Models/Entity.php missing SoftDeletes trait; app/Http/Middleware/CurrentEntity.php no session-membership check; navbar entry missing; EntityFactory slug not unique

scope.evidence: No out-of-scope members/settings pages added, but lang/en/ui.php + lang/pt_BR/ui.php delete ~35 existing keys and docs/database-schema.md deletes ~160 lines beyond the required update

security.evidence: EntityMembershipPolicy.php:29 owner-delete guard `=== UserRole::Owner->value` never matches so owner self-removal allowed; assignRole/update always false; CurrentEntity.php:48 no session-membership 403; CreateEntity.php no authorize/#[Validate]

simplicity.evidence: Lean models/policies/routes reuse Eloquent and Str::slug, but /home closure duplicates CurrentEntity dispatch and new app/Http/Kernel.php adds indirection for the alias

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ directory additions and no Pest cases for onboarding, switcher, pick, dashboard, policies, or Livewire unauthorized/tamper paths

review.summary: Adds entities, memberships, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding, switcher and dashboard with correct route names, but policy enum comparisons, void redirect, missing slug retry, broken soft deletes and middleware checks make the main paths incorrect or fatal. Destructive lang and schema-doc rewrites, missing Action/Validate/policy conventions, and zero tests require substantial rework before merge.
